info.name: IBM Bob Bookstore Capstone API Collection
info.description: REST API collection for the Book Worm store: 12-step customer journey, JWT auth, catalog filters and shelves, wishlist, followed writers, reviews, wallet, coupons, server-priced checkout and 48-hour cancellation. Folders 8 to 13 cover the slide 4 requirements: guest/member/admin entitlements and logout, stores and policies, catalogue administration, shipments and zone rates, order changes, returns and refunds, and up-sell / cross-sell. Money is in INR. Run folder 8's logins first; they store the tokens. Requests carry test scripts, so the collection can be run as a contract check.
